title: Wayfare Pass Plan Schedule — Membership Fees and Billing Periods
content:
# Wayfare Pass Plan Schedule: membership fees and billing periods

Each Wayfare Pass (rider membership) plan has one membership fee, which is the fee for one billing period of that plan, in USD. The billing period is either monthly or annual, and its length is stated in calendar months.

| Plan | Membership fee per billing period (USD) | Billing period | Length of one billing period |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | 4.99 | monthly | 1 calendar month |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | 9.99 | monthly | 1 calendar month |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | 96.00 | annual | 12 calendar months |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | 19.99 | monthly | 1 calendar month |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | 199.00 | annual | 12 calendar months |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | 249.00 | annual | 12 calendar months |

## Period end

On every plan the period end is found the same way: the period ends on the day before the same day-of-month, the period's length in calendar months later; when that day does not exist, the period ends on the last day of the shorter month.

Hypothetical illustrations of the period-end rule:

- A monthly period that starts on 15 March ends on 14 April.
- A monthly period that starts on 31 January has no 31 February to count from, so it ends on the last day of February (28 February, or 29 February in a leap year).
- An annual period that starts on 10 June ends on 9 June of the following year.

## Rounding

On every plan, every computed membership amount is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end of its computation. For a hypothetical computed amount of 12.345, the amount is 12.35; for 12.344 it is 12.34.

## Notes on the schedule

- The fee in the table is per billing period: the 96.00 of Wayfare Pass Annual covers twelve calendar months, while the 9.99 of Wayfare Pass Monthly covers one.
- The monthly plans are Wayfare Pass Student, Wayfare Pass Monthly and Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly; the annual plans are Wayfare Pass Annual, Wayfare Pass Plus Annual and Wayfare Pass All Access Annual.
